answer:
As of 15 October 2026, your records list two active prescriptions:

- Empagliflozin (Jardiance) 10 mg, one tablet each morning, for diabetes. Prescribed 20 February 2025.
- Atorvastatin 20 mg, one tablet once a day, for cholesterol. Prescribed 20 February 2025.

Metformin 500 mg is listed as ended on 15 April 2024, so it is not on your current list.

These are prescriptions on file, not proof of what you take. The records do not show pharmacy fills, so check your bottles and confirm with your pharmacy. Over-the-counter medicines and supplements are not recorded either, so tell your doctor about any you use.
